items.q: because we used to go on gigs with him

ctx.x: That's right. He's right about that. He's right about that. He sang, big fellow, heavy set, big, dark fellow. He'd sing all them big songs like 'Mother Macree.' He'd break up the house. (Unintelligible) because we used to go on gigs with him, you know, because we used to call -- it's called entertaining all them millionaires and things or out there in Oyster Bay where people have (unintelligible) them big yachts and all. He'd get up and sing. He played banjo. He didn't have to worry about playing banjo because he…
